name: Clive Barker's Undying

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Clive Barker's Undying only plays EAX reverb when its hardware 3D sound and spatial sound options are on.

notes: The game records whether EAX/A3D actually activated to Undying.log, which is handy for confirming it worked (per the Vogons Wiki citation for this title).
